title: Gold's place among the four precious metals by 20-day return

rule.signal: rank of gold's 20-day return among xau / xag / xpt / xpd on a common day
rule.entry: next gold daily open, stop 2 x ATR(20), out at the 5th close, one at a time
rule.costs: $0.60 a round trip + nights() x FIN.xau.long x entry on buys
rule.baseline: same-side trade after every common day of the same calendar year
rule.placebo: 40 seeds: same entry count per year drawn from that year's common days
rule.control: 40 seeds: other metals' 20-day returns shuffled across days of the same year

tests.what: gold last of the four by 20-day return: buy gold (primary)

control.what: other metals' R20 triplets shuffled across days of the same year

tests.what: gold first of the four by 20-day return: sell gold

control.what: other metals' R20 triplets shuffled across days of the same year

tests.what: gold first of the four by 20-day return: buy gold

control.what: other metals' R20 triplets shuffled across days of the same year
